reason: This PR looks worthy of a deep review. It is not a narrow local fix: it changes cross-layer MPP behavior in executor, planner, kv, and store paths to recover from TiFlash disaggregated memory-limit errors. Retry/recovery logic in distributed execution can easily hide High-severity issues such as wrong results, duplicated/partial execution, inconsistent task state, or bad fallback behavior, and the touched files include core planning and batch coprocessor flow rather than only tests or observability.
